name: Florida 4-H Junior Camp Counselor Program
city: Camp Cloverleaf and Camp Timpoochee, FL
what_you_do: Be the link between campers and staff at a 4-H summer camp. Lead activities, set the example, help staff, and follow a leadership track made for junior counselors.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 16 (age counted on September 1 of the 4-H year). You do not have to be a 4-H member.
pay_detail: Junior counselors pay the full early bird camp fee for each week they attend. They can apply for state camp scholarships.
duration: At least 1 camp week, Monday to Friday
deadline_text: The 2026 cycle ran Dec 1, 2025 to March 15, 2026. Applicants were told by April 1, 2026. Training was online in April and May.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. It names the camp and the weeks you want. Upload a resume. List two adults as references. They do not have to be from 4-H.
notes: Apply to Camp Cloverleaf, Camp Timpoochee or both. Weekly themes and prices are on each camp's page. Teens pay the camp fee, so this is not a paying job.
